ios.desc:
Most P6 students lose marks not because they got it wrong — but because they couldn’t show their working. LearnMathsToday fixes that.

Our AI marks every step of your child’s working — not just the final answer — and shows exactly where things went wrong. Like a tutor, but available at 11pm the night before a test.

45% of PSLE Paper 2 marks come from showing working. We’re the only app that actually marks it.

Free to start — 10 AI-marked questions per day, no credit card needed. Upgrade anytime for unlimited practice. Cancel in two taps.

What’s included:

- Step-by-step working feedback (not just right/wrong)
- Full PSLE question bank, MOE-aligned
- Handwriting input or typed answers
- Progress tracking by topic
- No sales calls. No lock-in.

Covers P5–P6 (PSLE) and Sec 1–4 (O-Level).

Optional upgrade: unlimited questions + full question bank. Cancel anytime from Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

android.desc:
Learn Maths Today: The Ultimate AI-Powered Math Learning Experience

Welcome to Learn Maths Today, the app that transforms the way students learn and master mathematics. With cutting-edge AI technology, our app offers personalized, interactive learning and automatic grading to make math fun, engaging, and effective for learners of all ages. Whether you're solving equations, exploring geometry, or diving into statistics, Learn Maths Today is your perfect companion on the journey to mathematical excellence.

Key Features
1. AI-Powered Auto-Grading
No need to wait for feedback! Our advanced AI analyzes your answers in real time, whether typed, drawn on our canvas, or uploaded as a photo. It provides instant, accurate grading—highlighting correct answers, partial solutions, and mistakes—so you can learn and improve faster.

2. Interactive Practice Questions
Get access to a vast library of questions, from basic arithmetic to advanced calculus. Each question is designed to challenge and develop your understanding, with hints and step-by-step breakdowns available for every problem.

3. Personalized Learning Paths
Our AI adapts to your progress, creating custom learning paths based on your strengths and areas for improvement. You'll never feel stuck or overwhelmed—Learn Maths Today ensures you’re always moving forward at your own pace.

4. Handwriting Recognition
Write your answers directly on the screen with your finger, stylus, or Apple Pencil. Our handwriting recognition system reads your solutions and grades them as if you were working with a real tutor.

5. Gamified Learning
Earn points, unlock achievements, and follow the story of a young tiger on a journey of self-discovery. The more you learn, the further your tiger progresses in their adventure—adding a fun, motivational twist to your studies.

6. Detailed Feedback & Analytics
Understand your performance with detailed reports and insights. See where you excel, track your progress, and identify topics that need more attention. With Learn Maths Today, you'll always know where you stand.

7. Multi-Input Options
Learning your way is easy. Solve problems by:

Writing on paper and uploading a photo of your work.
Typing your answers directly into the app.
Drawing or handwriting answers in our in-app canvas.

quotes.text:
I’m working on LearnMathsToday, a mobile app that helps students learn math in a fun and engaging way. It’s self-paced, with AI-generated questions that adapt to each student’s level. One unique feature is AI-powered marking, which gives instant feedback on written answers. I’ve also added gamification—points, levels, and a storyline—to keep students motivated. Right now, the app is based on the Singapore syllabus, since I’m based in Singapore.

Feel free to download here:

https://apps.apple.com/app/learnmathstoday/id6740993744

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.learnmathstoday.mainapp

https://learnmathstoday.com/
